answer: One workable design: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because velvet only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, ivory is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any harbor approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
